In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the present experimental data are in good agreement with the theoretical predictions of the TALYS code.
the measured cross-sections of (nat) Re(p,x)(183m)Os reaction were in good agreement with the theoretical predictions.

the measured data for the (185)Os and (181m)Re production are in good agreement with the theoretical predictions, while for the (183m)Re, the (183g)Re, the(181)Re and the (182)Os production the measured cross-section values are higher than the predictions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the experimental results for the investigated reactions are in good agreement with the predictions of theoretical codes.
the measured excitation functions are in good agreement with the predictions of TALYS-1.8 code.
the measured cross-section data were found to be consistent with the theoretical calculations and the data from the literature.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the activation cross-section data are important for the design and development of the new medical isotopes production facilities.
the activation data of the proton induced nuclear reactions are important for the production of medical radioisotopes and also for other applications.
